questions.stem: With which term is Data Mashup commonly confused, even though the two are totally different?
questions.explanation: Data Mashup is normally confused with Data Mesh, but the two are totally different.

options: A database that stores only unstructured data
A process for removing duplicate rows
A dashboard or web page whose data points come from multiple sources in a single view
A set of rules for naming tables
A machine learning model that runs itself
questions.explanation: A dashboard or web page with data points coming from multiple sources in a single view is called a Data Mashup.

questions.stem: From what idea does Data Mashup come?
options: Doing self-service on a single source of truth
Splitting data into training and testing sets
questions.explanation: Data Mashup comes from the idea of doing self-service on a single source of truth.

questions.stem: Which of the following are given as examples of sources feeding a Data Mashup dashboard?
options: Databases, Data Lakes and social media
questions.explanation: Dashboards with data coming from multiple sources, such as databases, Data Lakes and social media, are everyday examples of Data Mashup.

questions.stem: What is a Data Mashup called when it is done at the organisation level?
questions.explanation: At the organisation level a Data Mashup is also called an Enterprise Mashup.

questions.stem: In the Big Data era, what kinds of content are described as appearing together on one Data Mashup page?
questions.explanation: In the Big Data era, we have graphs, pictures and videos all on one page.

questions.stem: For which role is Data Mashup described as very useful, and why?
options: Data Analysts, to fetch data from different sources, make sense of it and build meaningful data for business decision making
questions.explanation: Data Mashup is very useful for Data Analysts who fetch data from different sources, make sense of it and build meaningful data for business decision making.

questions.stem: How common is Data Mashup in day-to-day practice, according to I Am Datapedia!?
options: It is a rare technique used only by researchers
It has been retired in favour of Data Mesh
We all do it daily through dashboards drawing on multiple sources
It is only used by government organisations
It is only possible with printed reports
questions.explanation: The author notes that nowadays we all do this daily, having dashboards with data coming from multiple sources.

questions.stem: Which statement about Data Mashup is NOT correct?
options: It presents data from multiple sources in a single view
It can include social media as a source
It is also called Enterprise Mashup at organisation level
It is another name for Data Mesh
It is useful for Data Analysts
questions.explanation: Data Mashup is often confused with Data Mesh, but the two are totally different concepts.

questions.stem: A web page shows a sales graph from a database alongside customer comments pulled from social media and a video from a Data Lake. What does this illustrate?
questions.explanation: A single web page or dashboard combining data points from multiple sources, including graphs, pictures and videos, is a Data Mashup.
